items.title: EIP-7594: PeerDAS - Peer Data Availability Sampling
items.description: Introducing simple DAS utilizing gossip distribution and peer requests. Extends EIP-4844 blobs using 1D erasure coding, column-based sampling, and introduces a 6-blob-per-transaction limit.

items.title: EIP-7823: Set Upper Bounds for MODEXP
items.description: Restricts each MODEXP precompile input field to a maximum of 8192 bits (1024 bytes) to reduce consensus bugs and simplify future EVMMAX replacement.

items.title: EIP-7825: Transaction Gas Limit Cap
items.description: Introduces a protocol-level cap on max gas per transaction to 16,777,216 (2^24) to enhance DoS resilience, improve network stability, and provide more predictable transaction processing.

items.title: EIP-7883: ModExp Gas Cost Increase
items.description: Modifies the ModExp precompile pricing algorithm from EIP-2565: increases minimum gas from 200 to 500, triples general cost, and doubles the cost for exponents larger than 32 bytes.

items.title: EIP-7892: Blob Parameter Only Hardforks
items.description: Defines BPO hardforks - a lightweight mechanism for incrementally scaling blob capacity through targeted hard forks that modify only blob-related parameters (target, max, baseFeeUpdateFraction).

items.title: EIP-7917: Deterministic Proposer Lookahead
items.description: Pre-calculates and stores a deterministic proposer_lookahead in the beacon state at the start of every epoch for MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1 epochs. Fixes next-epoch proposer schedule non-determinism and enables based preconfirmation protocols.

items.title: EIP-7918: Blob Base Fee Bounded by Execution Cost
items.description: Imposes a reserve price (BLOB_BASE_COST=2^13 * base_fee_per_gas) on blobs via an if-clause in calc_excess_blob_gas(). Ensures the blob fee market functions properly and blob consumers pay a relevant fraction of the market rate for compute.

items.title: EIP-7934: RLP Execution Block Size Limit
items.description: Introduces a protocol-level cap on max RLP-encoded execution block size to 10 MiB (MAX_BLOCK_SIZE), with a 2 MiB safety margin for beacon blocks, yielding MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE of ~8 MiB.

items.title: EIP-7935: Set Default Gas Limit to 60M
items.description: Recommends EL clients update their default gas limit configuration to 60M for Fusaka, up from the current 36M mainnet gas limit.

items.title: EIP-7939: Count Leading Zeros (CLZ) Opcode
items.description: Introduces CLZ opcode (0x1e) that pops x from the stack and pushes the number of leading zero bits (256 if x=0). Gas cost is 5. Used in math operations, compression, bitmaps, and post-quantum signature schemes.
